cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Understand the Hurt
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge why their action hurt, not merely agree that it happened.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put a thumbs-up on your dinner message like you do. All dealt with. Do you understand why it hurt after I lost my job?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My thumbs-up means I've read it. I thought asking about dinner would give you something normal.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, received. But can you see why I heard a job for the cook instead of concern for me?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I meant we could go out. I'll book somewhere.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I believe you. Before you book, tell me you understand why I needed 'How are you?' first.

reason: Make copied confidence create a specific misunderstanding in the same emotional task; preserve B contribution and avoid turning vulnerable requests into rubric explanations.
